subject: Renewal + Dedicated Capacity Scale: tokens/sec commitments & fallback plan
messages:
From: Anna Lyle <anna.lyle@edgetech.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Chen <luke.chen@edgetech.ai>, procurement@edgetech.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: capacity increase and tokens/sec ask

Hi Marissa,

Hope you had a good week. We're approaching our annual renewal and want to finalize the Dedicated capacity expansion we discussed in May. Quick summary of EdgeTech's ask:

- Add 12 A100-equivalent GPUs as a new reserved pool (separate from our existing 8-GPU pool).
- Formalize a tokens/sec (TPS) baseline guarantee for the new pool: target sustained 14k TPS for chat generation workloads and 30k TPS burst for 60s windows.
- Define fallback behavior if TPS or instance health is degraded (e.g., warm fallback to a smaller model, regional failover).
- Confirm cost delta for the additional reserved pool and any one-time onboarding fees.

Can you share a draft addendum we can review with procurement? We need legal and SRE sign-off by 6/15 to hit our production timeline.

Also attaching our internal forecast (we'll send the formal procurement request once terms are agreed).

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lyle
Head of Platform Engineering, EdgeTech
anna.lyle@edgetech.ai
(attachment: capacity-forecast-q3-q4.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lyle <anna.lyle@edgetech.ai>
Cc: Luke Chen <luke.chen@edgetech.ai>, procurement@edgetech.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: capacity increase and tokens/sec ask

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear summary. Really glad EdgeTech is growing into more Dedicated capacity.

High level response and next steps:

1) We can provision an isolated reserved pool with 12 A100-equivalent GPUs and set up a separate model routing policy so you can pin workloads independently.
2) For TPS commitments, I've attached a first-pass addendum that proposes:
   - Sustained guarantee: 14,000 tokens/sec (99th percentile per 5m window)
   - Burst allowance: up to 30,000 tokens/sec for cumulative 60s windows, limited to N bursts/month (we propose 6).
   - Measured at the pool ingress; fallback/triggers defined in section 3 of the attachment.
3) Fallbacks: default graceful degradation is to route to a lower-parameter variant we maintain for latency-sensitive traffic; cross-region failover is available but requires additional replication (cost shown in spreadsheet).
4) Pricing: line-itemed in the addendum PDF and capacity-schedule spreadsheet — includes reserved GPU rate, standby replication, and a one-time dedicated onboarding fee.

I'll copy our SRE (Karthik) and Product Ops (Stephanie) on the thread so we can align on SLA language and SLO math. Expect a redline-ready PDF by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(attachment: ET-renewal-addendum-draft.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: capacity increase and tokens/sec ask

Marissa / Stephanie — quick internal sync notes for the addendum redline: 

- Measurement and windowing: change the sustained guarantee to 99th percentile per 10-minute sliding window (more stable for high variance chat traffic). That reduces noisy alerts for EdgeTech's SRE.
- Bursts: propose soft-burst tiers: 30k TPS for up to 60s as requested, but any burst that triggers more than 3 breaches/month will automatically transition to a temporary throttling policy and we start a capacity review. Include an explicit exceptions process for planned campaigns.
- Fallback language: add explicit routing priority: 1) primary pool, 2) pinned lower-parameter model in same pool (no billing change), 3) regional warm-standby (additional replication cost). Add a requirement that EdgeTech provide a minimum 24-hour forecast for expected sustained increases over 20% to avoid unexpected throttles.
- Incident credits: define SLA credit bands tied to tokens/sec shortfalls (e.g., 5% credit for <95% of guaranteed TPS in a billing month; escalate to legal if sustained <85%). Keep credit calculation token-based, not dollar-based, per their preference.

I attached a short SLO extract (redwood-slo-definitions.md) with suggested language. If Stephanie signs off, we can fold into the PDF and push to DocuSign.

- Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-slo-definitions.md)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lyle <anna.lyle@edgetech.ai>, procurement@edgetech.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Luke Chen <luke.chen@edgetech.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Renewal addendum (12-GPU reserved pool) & SLO summary

Hi Anna — attaching the redlined addendum for your review (ET-renewal-addendum-draft.pdf) and the SLO extract we referenced. Key points in plain language:

- Provisioning: new dedicated reserved pool with 12 A100-equivalent GPUs, isolated routing, target go-live: 7/1/2027.
- Sustained TPS guarantee: 14,000 tokens/sec (99th pct, 10-min sliding window).
- Burst policy: up to 30,000 tokens/sec for 60s windows, allowed 6 bursts/month; 3+ bursts/month triggers a capacity review and possible temporary throttling.
- Fallbacks: automatic route to pinned lower-parameter variant; optional warm-standby cross-region failover (extra cost per spreadsheet).
- Credits & remediation: token-based credit bands; detailed examples in section 5 of the attached PDF.
- One-time onboarding fee and the monthly reserved cost are called out in the capacity-schedule.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) Procurement to review and confirm any redlines by 6/12.
2) If accepted, we'll send the DocuSign link and commit to the 7/1 go-live cadence (assuming timely approval).

Anna — happy to hop on a 30-min call this week with Karthik and Stephanie if you want to walk through the SLO language or the fallback sequencing.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(attachments: ET-renewal-addendum-draft.pdf, redwood-slo-definitions.md, capacity-schedule.xlsx)
